svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, Go, Rust, GNU Bash. Front end: Vue.js, Nuxt, React, Next.js, Astro. Back end & data: Node.js, Bun, PostgreSQL, MySQL. Infra: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, OpenTofu, Terraform, Cloudflare, Hetzner, Traefik Proxy. Ship & watch: GitHub Actions, Grafana, Prometheus, Linux
